hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom swap curve for ETH/phiETH pairs by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking input tokens from the PoolManager, converting ETH↔phiETH via deposit/withdraw, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta that fully bypasses the AMM's concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions to the pool are unconditionally reverted.
